name: A01_7_two_fliers_entering_at_once_trigger_it_twice
notes: Printed: 'Whenever another creature you control with flying enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.' There is no 'one or more': it triggers once for EACH creature. Two Mistral Singers enter in one instruction (one event, CR 603.2c: the move op with keys), so the Watcher gets two triggers: 2/2 -> 4/4. The engine asks the controller the order of the two waiting triggers (CR 603.3b); either order gives the same result.
